line: A chubby orange cat stands trial for testing gravity and 4 a.m. parkour, and walks free.
line_cn: 橘猫胖橘被立案审查：测试重力、凌晨跑酷，最后无罪释放。

camera.move: Locked frontal with a small beat pulse (~0.6 %)
camera.expresses: the page as a poster, grooving
camera.serves: a title; a list; an accusation
a profile; a summary before a verdict
a stamp; a crash; a landing

camera.move: Flash frames (white overlay ≤ 0.95 → 0, capped at 0.5 for big hits)
camera.serves: a mugshot; a verdict; evidence found
a timeline; suspects; a chain of events

camera.move: Snap zoom into a halftone detail until dots are huge
camera.serves: a fingerprint; a signature; a number

camera.move: Pull back to reveal the whole desk
camera.expresses: the file is one among many

transitions: Transitions: dot wipe or hard cut;
labels: Headlines: a black-weight serif (e.g. Noto Serif SC 900 for CJK; a black slab for Latin), 100–230 px, left-aligned near the margin, with a misregistration shadow (+8/+8 px in the overprint ink, multiplied).
Display / numerals: a fat rounded display face (e.g. Bagel Fat One) for names, big numbers, times.
Interjections: a playful hand face (e.g. ZCOOL KuaiLe), paper fill with a thick ink stroke and an offset shadow.
Data / HUD: a heavy monospace (e.g. JetBrains Mono 800) for case numbers, dates, rulers, file names.
motion: 30 fps transforms; line boil at ~10 fps on characters, so the drawing breathes while positions stay smooth.
Everything enters with overshoot (back ease, 0.3–0.45 s): rising from below the frame or scaling from 0. Nothing fades in.
Per-character pop for headlines: each glyph drops 30–100 px and squashes in, stagger 0.05–0.08 s (0.02 s for small text).
Stamp slam: ~0.09 s from ~2.6× to 1× (ease-in), then a small damped bounce; camera shake, flash and stamp sound on the same frame.

native_moves.name: The accusation frame
native_moves.does: A topic becomes "the case of X": list its counts.
native_moves.fits: a cognitive bias on trial; a city's traffic problem; a plant that won't stop growing.

native_moves.name: Numbered exhibits
native_moves.does: Each beat gets a giant halftone numeral behind it.
native_moves.fits: five causes of a blackout; three clauses of a contract; the stages of a recall.

native_moves.name: The stamp
native_moves.does: A verdict is a physical slam.
native_moves.fits: APPROVED on a grant; EXPIRED on a policy; VERIFIED on a rumour check.

native_moves.name: The mugshot
native_moves.does: Frontal subject, height chart, name plate, flash.
native_moves.fits: a new species; a product teardown; the "suspect" in a bug report.

native_moves.name: Evidence board
native_moves.does: Exhibits pinned and linked with string, then shaken.
native_moves.fits: a supply chain; a family tree; a heist's timeline.

native_moves.name: Dot density = emotion
native_moves.does: Dots swell into a halo, crowd the edges for tension, bloom radially for joy.
native_moves.fits: a record broken; a deadline closing in; a reunion.

native_moves.name: Redaction
native_moves.does: Black bars print over words and lift one by one.
native_moves.fits: a leaked memo; a surprise party plan; spoilers.

score.note: synth pop-print: marimba-like pluck melody, square bass, snaps for sneaking
